name: matik-game
description: A Matiks-style competitive mental math game: practice sprints, cross-math puzzles, and (soon) real-time duels.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.start: concurrently -n server,web "npm run start -w server" "npm run start -w web"
scripts.start:prod: SERVE_WEB=1 NODE_ENV=production npm run start -w server
